name: boomi-dashboard
description: Boomi Companion at a glance while you build: each component's stage, what needs attention, the live environment and the session's cost

paneTheme.title: Pane colors
paneTheme.description: The pane's colors until you pick a theme in the pane or with /bc-dashboard theme: day (Valence Day, light, with its own background), night (Valence Night, dark) or terminal (your terminal's theme)

flamingo.title: Flamingo
flamingo.description: Show the 8-bit flamingo in the pane: standing on one leg while Claude is idle, walking while it works

recentHours.title: Live environment window (hours)
recentHours.description: How far back the live environment's runs count; older failures are not shown or flagged

envFile.title: Companion .env file
envFile.description: Path of Boomi Companion's .env, relative to the session's working directory; the dashboard reads the Platform API credentials and BOOMI_ENVIRONMENT_ID from it

componentsDir.title: Components folder
componentsDir.description: Where Boomi Companion keeps component XML; edits to files under it show up as edited components

pollSeconds.title: Platform poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often to check Boomi for the environment's runs and the watched components; 0 turns polling off

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Pop up a toast when a step fails, a deploy or test finishes, a run fails in the environment, or a watched component changes

banner.title: Banner above the prompt
banner.description: Show the latest Companion step and what needs attention above the prompt
